title: ClickPoint
description: A data-driven GUI mod that supports native gif rendering and designed to be intuitive and approachable.
body:
Click-Point is a data-driven mod aimed towards mod and modpack creators for easy GUI creation through datapacks! 

Current Features:
- Native GIF Rendering Support through Client Life Cycle Events
- Versatile Customization and Utilization such as command execution

Planned Features:
- 3D Renders for easy viewing
- Placeholders for easy to generate text
- Grid Snapping Toggles in the editor
